papers.title: Gradients Know What Outcomes Don't: Unlocking Reinforcement Learning for LLM Reasoning with Gradient-Aligned Rewards
papers.what: Builds a dense reinforcement-learning reward by taking truncated gradients through the output projection layer for each rollout and scoring their cosine similarity against an expert-solution anchor gradient, adding under 9 percent wall-clock overhead and improving over GRPO on competition mathematics with transfer to GPQA Diamond and MMLU-Pro.

papers.title: An Open Recipe for IMO Gold: Training Nemotron for Olympiad Mathematics
papers.authors: Moshkov, Ge, Armstrong, Du, Mahdavi, Gitman (NVIDIA)
papers.what: Post-trains two Nemotron 3 Ultra specialists by supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, then runs an iterative generate-verify-refine search across three checkpoints in natural language with no formal prover or external tools, scoring 30 out of 42 at IMO 2026 and releasing checkpoints, data, code, and a 200-problem benchmark.

papers.title: SpatialBlock: Enhancing Spatial Intelligence in LVLMs via Synthetic Block-Stacking Problem
papers.what: Replaces annotation-heavy real-scene spatial supervision with 15,000 fully synthetic block-stacking problems covering 3D-to-2D projection, viewpoint transformation, and structural combination, plus controlled colour cues for anchor-based reasoning, and shows both direct-answer and reasoning variants transfer to real-scene spatial benchmarks.

papers.title: EvoSafeHarness: Evolving Model- and Domain-Specific Harnesses for Securing Agents
papers.authors: Li, Ma, Cao, Suh, Li, Song, Xiao
papers.what: Searches jointly over a natural-language safety policy and the executable code that enforces it at every tool call for a frozen model in a target domain, cutting DecodingTrust-Agent attack success from 45.6 to 10.0 percent for 3.3 utility points and reaching 82.8 percent utility at 0.0 percent attack success on AgentDojo.
